page_title: MCI 3-1 BOU | Manchester City v Bournemouth 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Manchester City take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+5' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

90+3' A cross by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
90+3' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+2' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+2' Flag goes up against Evanilson (Bournemouth) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Bernardo Silva is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Rodri (Manchester City).
90' Substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) has come on for Phil Foden.
89' Ben Doak (Bournemouth) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
88' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
87' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
86' The cross into the penalty area from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
85' A cross from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
84' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
84' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
82' Substitution. Erling Haaland makes way for Omar Marmoush (Manchester City).
81' The number of shots on goal at present is 7:5.
80' Andoni Iraola is forced to make a change. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is unable to continue due to injury, Ben Doak comes on.
79' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will take a corner kick.
79' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
78' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
77' Savinho (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
76' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
75' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Scott leaves the pitch and Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) comes on.
73' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Rayan Cherki and he is replaced by Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City).
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Savinho (Manchester City) is replacing Jeremy Doku.
70' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post.
68' Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' A short pass finds Rayan Cherki (Manchester City). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
67' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) but poses no threat.
65' It's a yellow card for Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth).
65' Manchester City are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
63' One of the Bournemouth players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Manchester City are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
62' That will be all from David Brooks who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
62' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) replaces Alejandro Jimenez.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Evanilson (Bournemouth) replaces Eli Junior Kroupi.
60' 3 - 1 Goal! Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.

59' David Brooks (Bournemouth) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma!
58' The game is interrupted now, Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
56' Phil Foden (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
55' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
55' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
54' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) prepares to take a corner kick.
54' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Gianluigi Donnarumma, who makes a comfortable save.
53' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
52' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gianluigi Donnarumma, who smothers the ball.
51' Close! Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
50' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) tries to find Eli Junior Kroupi, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
49' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma was alert and made a comfortable save.
48' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Erling Haaland (Manchester City) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
47' The free kick is delivered by Alex Scott (Bournemouth) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
46' A player from Manchester City takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him.
45+5' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down. Manchester City are awarded a free kick.
45+3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth).
45+2' What was Phil Foden (Manchester City) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+2' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
43' Looks like Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

43' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. Manchester City have a free kick.
42' One of the Manchester City players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
39' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Manchester City have a corner.

37' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Djordje Petrovic makes a great save to stop his effort.
36' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes.
35' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.

33' 2 - 1 Goal! Great play by Rayan Cherki releases Erling Haaland (Manchester City) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 2:1.
32' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
30' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' The Manchester City players can’t believe it after referee Anthony Taylor signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
30' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Manchester City. Let’s see what happens!
29' Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
29' This shall not pass! Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
26' Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
26' Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) goes wild in celebration.
26' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Bournemouth goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
25' 1 - 1 Goal! Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
24' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Bernardo Silva, but Djordje Petrovic displays great awareness to stop him.
22' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
20' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is teed up on the edge of the box by Rayan Cherki, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
16' The ball is cleared after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

15' Marcus Tavernier almost found himself in a promising position after Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
15' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
12' A pass finds the feet of Erling Haaland (Manchester City) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
11' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
10' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
9' Anthony Taylor blows the whistle, Nico (Manchester City) is penalised for a foul.
7' The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
7' The resulting corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is cleared by the defence.
6' Phil Foden (Manchester City) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
5' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
4' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) has a goal ruled out for offside!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will referee today's match.
